node.title: Re^7: use 5.005 with perl v5.16.3
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: You said you have different Perl versions on each server but you haven't said what they are. Could you please post the output of perl -V from each server, as well as the output of find /perl/perl_for_siji `perl -e 'print "@INC"'` -path '*JSON/PP.pm' -exec grep -Hn VERSION '{}' + from each server? (both inside tags)
